title: Lead sync
intro: Send approved lead updates to Google Sheets, HubSpot or Zoho. Your workspace keeps every lead even when a destination is unavailable.
denied: Only owners and admins can manage lead sharing.
loadError: Could not load lead sync. Try again.
error: Could not save this change. Check the connection, required fields and sharing approval, then try again.
saved: Change saved. Queued work runs shortly.
label: Connection label
hubHelp: Use a HubSpot private-app token with Contacts read/write and property read access. The app must also be able to read and create associated notes. Credentials are encrypted and never displayed again.
zohoHelp: Use Zoho self-client OAuth credentials with Leads read/create/update, Notes read/create, Fields read and secure search read permissions. Choose the data centre for your Zoho account.
googleHelp: Google grants access only to spreadsheets created or opened with this app. Create a dedicated export spreadsheet after connecting. Your Calendar connection is separate. (drive.file)
googlePending: Google Sheets setup is pending. Ask your administrator to configure the Google OAuth app.
disconnectPrompt: Disconnect this account and stop queued exports? Local leads stay saved. Revoke remote access separately in your provider account settings.
sheetHelp: Every new or updated lead appends a row. Existing rows remain unchanged. Use an empty export tab with the standard header; start a new tab after 50,000 rows.
mappingHelp: Map each destination once. Map phone to Phone/Mobile or email to Email for matching. Fields marked * are required. Only mapped fields are updated; a summary and conversation link are added as a note.
consent: I approve sending these lead fields to this account.
backfillPrompt: Export the latest {count} existing leads to this account using the saved settings? Previously exported versions are not duplicated.
jobHelp: Latest 100 operations. New versions sync automatically after sharing is enabled. Failed exports keep the local lead; retry after correcting the problem.
operationError: This operation needs attention. Test the connection and check its settings before retrying.

failures.credentials_required: Access expired or permissions are missing. Reconnect this account.
failures.ambiguous_identity: Several CRM records match this identity. Resolve duplicates before retrying.
failures.missing_identity: A valid mapped phone number or email is required.
failures.required_field_missing: A required CRM field has no lead value.
failures.export_header_mismatch: The tab has a different header. Choose an empty dedicated export tab.
failures.export_tab_full: The export tab reached 50,000 rows. Choose a new tab.
failures.creation_unconfirmed: Record creation is uncertain. Retry to check for the existing record before another export.
failures.append_unconfirmed: An append is uncertain. Retry checks for its event ID without duplicating rows.
failures.note_unconfirmed: A note write is uncertain. Retry checks for the existing note.
failures.connection_changed: The connection or sharing settings changed; this operation was stopped.
failures.superseded: A newer lead version already reached the CRM.
failures.rate_limited: The provider quota is busy. Delivery will retry automatically.
